definition_en: a person whose job is to amuse an audience
core_image: 舞台灯亮起，一个人向前一步，把全场的目光和笑声握在手里
scene: 游轮上那位唱歌的表演者每晚都要连唱两场。The entertainer on the cruise ship sings two shows every night.
sceneCN: 这里 entertainer 是「表演者」（第 1 个义项：以娱乐观众为职业的人）；句意：游轮上的那位表演者每晚要唱两场。

senses.title: A performer who amuses audiences
senses.definition: a person whose job is to entertain people, especially on stage or screen
senses.definitionCN: 以娱乐他人为职业的人，尤指在舞台或屏幕上
senses.example: The entertainer kept the whole room laughing.
senses.exampleCN: 这位表演者让整个房间笑声不断。
senses.why: The -er suffix names the person who carries out the action of entertaining.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -er 指执行 entertain 这一动作的人。

senses.title: A host who looks after guests
senses.definition: a person who is good at receiving and amusing guests
senses.definitionCN: 善于接待并逗客人开心的人
senses.example: As a host, she was a natural entertainer.
senses.exampleCN: 作为主人，她天生善于待客。
senses.why: The older hospitality sense of the verb produces this social meaning of the person.
senses.whyCN: 动词古老的「待客」义项，产生了这个指人的社交含义。

senses.title: A charming social person
senses.definition: someone who is lively and good at amusing people in company
senses.definitionCN: 在人群中活泼、善于逗乐的人
senses.example: He is a born entertainer, always at the centre of the party.
senses.exampleCN: 他天生会活跃气氛，总是聚会中的中心。
senses.why: Someone who holds a group's attention at home is described with the stage word.
senses.whyCN: 能在家里留住一群人注意力的人，就用舞台上的词来描述。

intro.en: Entertainer is entertain plus the English suffix -er, with the verb coming from Old French entretenir, to hold together.
intro.cn: entertainer 是 entertain 加英语词尾 -er，动词来自古法语 entretenir（使相聚、维持）。

items.en: Tenere means to hold or keep.
items.cn: tenere 意为握住、保持。

items.en: Tenir continues the verb for holding.
items.cn: tenir 延续表示「握住」的动词。

items.en: Entretenir means to keep together or maintain.
items.cn: entretenir 意为使相聚、维持。

items.en: Middle English entretinen gives the base verb.
items.cn: 中古英语 entretinen 提供基础动词。

items.en: The -er noun appears for people who amuse audiences.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，出现指娱乐观众的 -er 名词。

items.en: Entertainer covers stage, screen, and social life.
items.cn: 现代英语中，entertainer 涵盖舞台、屏幕与社交生活。

note.en: Entertainer is the person noun of entertain, and it sits near performer and host words.
note.cn: entertainer 是 entertain 的人物名词，与 performer 和 host 类词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who acts, sings, or dances for an audience
a person who creates or performs art
a person who receives guests or presents a show

normalIntro.en: Entertainer is simply entertain plus -er, so it names the person who holds an audience.
normalIntro.cn: entertainer 就是 entertain 加 -er，指那个留住观众的人。

normal.en: Add -er to entertain and you get the person who does it.
normal.cn: 在 entertain 后加 -er，就得到做这件事的人。

normal.en: The -er ending appears in teacher and singer in exactly the same way.
normal.cn: -er 词尾在 teacher 与 singer 中也是同样的用法。

normal.en: An entertainer holds attention, and the audience gives it freely.
normal.cn: 表演者留住注意力，而观众是自愿给出的。

normal.en: Entertainment is the show, while entertainer is the one on stage.
normal.cn: entertainment 是节目，entertainer 是台上的那个人。

normal.en: Compare performer: every entertainer performs, but not every performer entertains.
normal.cn: 对比 performer：每位 entertainer 都在表演，但并非每位 performer 都能娱乐人。

abstract.en: Picture a single spotlight finding one person at the edge of the stage.
abstract.cn: 想象一束光打在舞台边缘的一个人身上。

abstract.en: Imagine a room going quiet, then breaking into applause.
abstract.cn: 想象房间先安静下来，随后爆发出掌声。

abstract.en: Think of a smile passed from the stage to the back row.
abstract.cn: 想象一个微笑从舞台传到最后一排。

examples.en: The entertainer kept the whole room laughing.
examples.cn: 这位表演者让整个房间笑声不断。

examples.en: She works as a children's entertainer at parties.
examples.cn: 她在聚会上做儿童娱乐表演。

examples.en: A good entertainer knows how to read the audience.
examples.cn: 好的表演者懂得如何读懂观众。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「entertain + er」——做 entertain 这件事的人，就是表演者；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 tenere（握住）→ 古法语 entretenir（使相聚、维持）→ 中古英语 entretinen → entertain（招待、娱乐）＋ -er → entertainer（表演者）。

sensesIntro.en: The person noun grows straight out of the verb: one who holds attention on stage, one who holds guests at home, and one who holds a party together.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个人物名词直接从动词生长出来：在舞台上留住注意力的人、在家里留住客人的人、把聚会维系起来的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one figure on a lit stage holding a whole audience's attention.
core.cn: 核心意象：灯光下的一个身影，握住全场观众的注意力。

branches.en: The professional performer is the main modern sense.
branches.cn: 职业表演者，是现代主要义项。

branches.en: The good host carries the old hospitality sense.
branches.cn: 好客的主人延续古老的待客义项。

branches.en: The lively guest keeps a social gathering amused.
branches.cn: 活泼的人让社交聚会保持欢乐。

branches.en: Stage and home both need someone who holds attention.
branches.cn: 舞台与家庭都需要能留住注意力的人。

branches.en: Professional charm and social charm share the same skill.
branches.cn: 职业魅力与社交魅力共享同一种本领。

intro.en: Entertainer is an English -er noun built on entertain, whose core is a Latin verb for holding.
intro.cn: entertainer 是建立在 entertain 上的英语 -er 名词，其核心是表示「握住」的拉丁动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere means to hold; French entretenir means to keep together, and English adds -er for the person.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tenere 表示握住；法语 entretenir 表示使相聚，英语再加 -er 表示人。

definition_en: shows, activities, or hospitality that amuse people or look after guests
core_image: 灯光、音乐与笑声组成的一整晚，还有摆满食物的餐桌
scene: 演出开始前，剧场经理说今晚的娱乐节目会持续到午夜。Before the show began, the theatre manager said the evening's entertainment would last until midnight.
sceneCN: 这里 entertainment 是「娱乐节目」（第 1 个义项：使人开心的演出或活动）；句意：演出开始前，剧场经理说今晚的娱乐节目会持续到午夜。

senses.title: Shows and activities that amuse
senses.definition: films, music, games, or other things that give people pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 电影、音乐、游戏等给人快乐的事物
senses.example: The hotel offers live entertainment every evening.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒店每晚都有现场娱乐表演。
senses.why: The noun names the things produced when people are entertained.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指人们被娱乐时所产生的事物。

senses.title: The act of entertaining guests
senses.definition: the activity of welcoming and looking after guests
senses.definitionCN: 迎接并照顾客人的活动
senses.example: Their hospitality was more than mere entertainment.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的好客不只是表面的招待。
senses.why: The old hospitality sense of the verb survives in the noun.
senses.whyCN: 动词古老的待客义项在名词中保留下来。

senses.title: A performance or event
senses.definition: a particular show or event that people watch for pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 人们为消遣而观看的某场演出或活动
senses.example: The concert was good entertainment for the whole family.
senses.exampleCN: 这场音乐会对全家来说都是很好的消遣。
senses.why: One instance of amusing activity is counted as a piece of entertainment.
senses.whyCN: 一次具体的娱乐活动，就算作一件娱乐节目。

items.en: Middle English entretinen gives the base verb.

items.en: The noun entertainment appears for hospitality and amusement.

items.en: Public shows and the entertainment industry expand the word.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪，公共演出与娱乐业扩展了这个词的用法。

items.en: Modern English uses entertainment for both shows and hospitality.
items.cn: 现代英语中，entertainment 既指节目，也指待客。

note.en: Entertainment is the -ment noun of entertain, and it sits near its family and near words for amusement and shows.

the feeling of finding something funny or enjoyable
activity done for pleasure when not working

normalIntro.cn: entertainment 是 entertain 加 -ment，指招待与娱乐所带来的快乐和节目。

normal.en: The ending -ment turns the verb into the activity or its result.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ment 把动词变成活动或活动的结果。

normal.en: The entertainment industry is built on holding attention.
normal.cn: 娱乐业建立在「留住注意力」之上。

normal.en: Live entertainment means performers in front of a real audience.
normal.cn: live entertainment 指真人在观众面前表演。

normal.en: For entertainment is the phrase that names the purpose.
normal.cn: for entertainment 是说明目的的常用短语。

normal.en: Compare amusement: amusement is often the feeling, while entertainment is often the show.
normal.cn: 对比 amusement：amusement 常指感受，entertainment 常指节目。

abstract.en: Picture a theatre before the curtain rises, seats filling with chatter.
abstract.cn: 想象大幕拉开前的剧场，座位间满是交谈声。

abstract.en: Imagine a table cleared for cards and laughter after dinner.
abstract.cn: 想象晚饭后桌子被清出来打牌，笑声不断。

abstract.en: Think of a band tuning up while the lights dim.
abstract.cn: 想象灯光变暗，乐队正在调音。

examples.en: The hotel offers live entertainment every evening.
examples.cn: 这家酒店每晚都有现场娱乐表演。

examples.en: Their hospitality was more than mere entertainment.
examples.cn: 他们的好客不只是表面的招待。

examples.en: The concert was good entertainment for the whole family.
examples.cn: 这场音乐会对全家来说都是很好的消遣。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「entertain + ment」——把人留住、让人开心的那件事，就是娱乐；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 tenere（握住）→ 古法语 entretenir（使相聚、维持）→ 中古英语 entretinen → entertain（招待、娱乐）＋ -ment → entertainment（娱乐；招待）。

sensesIntro.en: The noun covers the feeling and activity of being amused, the old duty of looking after guests, and the concrete shows that produce pleasure.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词涵盖被娱乐的感受与活动、古老的待客职责，以及产生快乐的具体节目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an evening of lights, music, and laughter shared with others.
core.cn: 核心意象：灯光、音乐与笑声共享的一晚。

branches.en: Shows and games are the most visible form of entertainment.
branches.cn: 演出与游戏是最显眼的娱乐形式。

branches.en: Hospitality is entertainment in its oldest social form.
branches.cn: 待客是娱乐最古老的社交形式。

branches.en: A single performance is counted as one entertainment.
branches.cn: 一场演出可算作一项娱乐活动。

branches.en: The industry produces events, and each event is an entertainment.
branches.cn: 娱乐业生产活动，每场活动就是一项娱乐。

branches.en: A host's evening and a public show both aim at pleasure.
branches.cn: 主人的晚宴与公开演出都以快乐为目标。

intro.en: Entertainment is an English -ment noun built on the French-shaped verb entertain.
intro.cn: entertainment 是建立在法语形态动词 entertain 上的英语 -ment 名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin core is tenere, to hold; French entretenir keeps people together, and English adds -ment.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁核心是 tenere（握住）；法语 entretenir 使人相聚，英语再加 -ment。

items.exampleCN: entre- 出现在 entretenir 开头。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的词尾

items.example: Entertainment names the activity and its result.

definition_en: a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something
core_image: 胸口像被一团火点着，忍不住向前倾身去做那件事
scene: 听说球队要打决赛，整条街的人都兴奋地讨论起来。When the team reached the final, the whole street discussed it with enthusiasm.
sceneCN: 这里 enthusiasm 是「热情」（第 1 个义项：强烈的兴奋与兴趣）；句意：球队打进决赛时，整条街的人都热情地讨论这件事。

senses.title: Strong excitement and interest
senses.definition: a strong feeling of eagerness and interest in something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物强烈的渴望与兴趣
senses.example: She spoke about the project with great enthusiasm.
senses.exampleCN: 她满腔热情地谈起这个项目。
senses.why: The Greek source describes a god within, and that inner fire becomes strong excited interest.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语来源描述「心中有神」，这种内心之火就变成强烈的兴奋与兴趣。

senses.title: An object of passionate interest
senses.definition: an activity or subject that someone pursues with great eagerness
senses.definitionCN: 某人满怀热忱去从事的活动或主题
senses.example: Gardening is one of her lifelong enthusiasms.
senses.exampleCN: 园艺是她终身的爱好之一。
senses.why: The feeling is transferred to the thing that produces it.
senses.whyCN: 这种情感被转移到产生它的事物上。

senses.title: Fervent devotion to a cause
senses.definition: intense and sometimes uncritical devotion to a belief or cause
senses.definitionCN: 对信念或事业强烈、有时缺乏批判的投入
senses.example: His early enthusiasm for the movement later cooled.
senses.exampleCN: 他早年对这场运动的狂热后来冷却了。
senses.why: The original religious intensity survives in this formal sense of devoted zeal.
senses.whyCN: 原初的宗教强度保留在这个正式的「热诚」义项中。

intro.en: Enthusiasm comes from Greek enthousiasmos, divine possession, from entheos, having a god within, built on en- and theos, god.
intro.cn: enthusiasm 来自希腊语 enthousiasmos（神灵附体），源于 entheos（心中有神），由 en- 与 theos（神）构成。

items.en: Theos means god.
items.cn: theos 意为神。

items.en: Entheos means having a god within, inspired.
items.cn: entheos 意为心中有神、受神灵启发的。

items.en: Enthousiasmos means divine possession or inspired frenzy.
items.cn: enthousiasmos 意为神灵附体、受神启的狂热。

items.en: Enthusiasmus carries the term into learned Latin.
items.cn: enthusiasmus 把这个词带入学术拉丁语。

items.en: English adopts enthusiasm for possession by a god.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，英语用 enthusiasm 表示神灵附体。

items.en: The word now means strong excited interest in almost anything.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词表示对几乎任何事物的强烈兴趣。

note.en: Enthusiasm is a fire word, and it sits near its own family and near words for passion and zeal.
note.cn: enthusiasm 是一个「火焰」词，与自身词族以及表示激情和热忱的词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who is very interested in something
in an eager and excited way
a very strong feeling or interest
the state of wanting something very much

normalIntro.en: Enthusiasm comes from Greek entheos, having a god within: the word pictures fire inside a person.
normalIntro.cn: enthusiasm 来自希腊语 entheos（心中有神）：这个词描绘人体内的一团火。

normal.en: Theos means god, so enthusiasm once meant divine possession.
normal.cn: theos 意为神，所以 enthusiasm 原指神灵附体。

normal.en: Modern enthusiasm is simply strong excitement and interest.
normal.cn: 现代的 enthusiasm 就是强烈的兴奋与兴趣。

normal.en: Enthusiasm for something is the usual pattern with a noun.
normal.cn: enthusiasm for something 是常见的名词搭配。

normal.en: The adjective is enthusiastic, and the person is an enthusiast.
normal.cn: 形容词是 enthusiastic，指人是 enthusiast。

normal.en: Compare passion: passion burns quietly, while enthusiasm shows itself openly.
normal.cn: 对比 passion：passion 安静地燃烧，enthusiasm 则外露。

abstract.en: Picture a spark catching dry grass and spreading fast.
abstract.cn: 想象火星落在干草上，迅速蔓延。

abstract.en: Imagine a child pulling a parent toward a festival tent.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子拉着父母往节日的帐篷跑。

abstract.en: Think of a room leaning forward to hear one voice.
abstract.cn: 想象整个房间的人都前倾身体听一个声音。

examples.en: She spoke about the project with great enthusiasm.
examples.cn: 她满腔热情地谈起这个项目。

examples.en: His enthusiasm for music began at school.
examples.cn: 他对音乐的热情始于学校。

examples.en: The crowd's enthusiasm lifted the players.
examples.cn: 观众的热情鼓舞了球员。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「en-theos」——心里住着一位神，所以热情高涨；这只是词源拆解式联想，与日常读音无关。

root: 希腊语 theos（神）→ entheos（心中有神的）→ enthousiasmos（神灵附体般的激情）→ 拉丁语 enthusiasmus → 英语 enthusiasm。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins as divine possession, softens into religious fervor, and finally becomes the everyday fire of strong interest.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词最初指神灵附体，后淡化为宗教热诚，最终成为日常所说的强烈兴趣之火。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fire lit inside a person that pushes them forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：心中燃起一团火，推着人向前。

branches.en: Strong excited interest is the everyday modern sense.
branches.cn: 强烈兴奋的兴趣，是现代日常义项。

branches.en: The thing that lights the fire becomes an enthusiasm too.
branches.cn: 点燃火焰的事物本身也被称作 enthusiasm。

branches.en: Devotion to a cause keeps the original intensity.
branches.cn: 对事业的投入保留了原初的强度。

branches.en: People feel enthusiasm, and their hobbies are their enthusiasms.
branches.cn: 人怀有热情，而爱好就是他们所热衷的事物。

branches.en: A lifelong hobby and a cause can both command devotion.
branches.cn: 终身爱好与事业都能赢得投入。

intro.en: Enthusiasm is a Greek word that reached English through Latin, and English endings form its modern family.
intro.cn: enthusiasm 是经拉丁语进入英语的希腊词，现代词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Greek theos means god, and entheos means having a god within; Latin enthusiasmus carries the word westward.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 theos 表示神，entheos 表示心中有神；拉丁语 enthusiasmus 把这个词带向西方。

Entheos gives the image of inner fire.
items.exampleCN: entheos 提供内心之火的画面。

items.example: Enthousiasmos is the direct Greek source.
items.exampleCN: enthousiasmos 是直接的希腊语来源。

items.example: Enthusiasmus carries the term into Latin.
items.exampleCN: enthusiasmus 把这个词带入拉丁语。

items.exampleCN: 这个名词保留希腊语 -ismos 的形态。

definition_en: showing strong excitement and interest
core_image: 眼睛里发亮，身体前倾，抢着把喜欢的事说给别人听
scene: 新来的志愿者一进门就热情地介绍起周末的活动安排。The new volunteer was enthusiastic about the weekend programme from the moment she arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 enthusiastic 是「热情的」（第 1 个义项：表现出强烈兴趣）；句意：新志愿者一进门就对周末的活动安排充满热情。

senses.title: Showing strong eager interest
senses.definition: showing a lot of excitement and interest in something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物表现出大量兴奋与兴趣
senses.example: The children were enthusiastic about the trip.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们对这次旅行充满热情。
senses.why: The -ic adjective turns the inner fire of enthusiasm into a visible quality.
senses.whyCN: -ic 形容词把 enthusiasm 的内心之火变成看得见的品质。

senses.title: Eager to take part
senses.definition: very willing to join an activity or help
senses.definitionCN: 非常愿意参加活动或提供帮助
senses.example: The volunteers were enthusiastic about starting work at once.
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者们恨不得马上开始工作。
senses.why: Eagerness to act is enthusiasm directed at doing something.
senses.whyCN: 急于行动，就是指向做事的热情。

senses.title: Expressing warm approval
senses.definition: showing strong and warm support for a plan or idea
senses.definitionCN: 对计划或想法表现出强烈而热烈的支持
senses.example: The plan won enthusiastic support from the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 这项计划赢得了全队的热烈支持。
senses.why: Approval becomes enthusiastic when it is expressed with the same heat as interest.
senses.whyCN: 当赞同以与兴趣同样的热度表达出来，就成了「热烈赞同」。

intro.en: Enthusiastic is enthusiasm with the adjective ending -ic, from Greek entheos, having a god within.
intro.cn: enthusiastic 是 enthusiasm 加形容词词尾 -ic，源于希腊语 entheos（心中有神）。

items.en: Theos means god, and entheos means inspired by a god.
items.cn: theos 意为神，entheos 意为受神启发的。

items.en: Enthousiasmos means divine possession or inspired fervor.
items.cn: enthousiasmos 意为神灵附体或受神启的热忱。

items.en: Enthusiasmus brings the noun into Latin learning.
items.cn: enthusiasmus 把这个名词带入拉丁学术。

items.en: Enthusiasm enters English with its religious intensity.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，enthusiasm 带着宗教强度进入英语。

items.en: The ending -ic forms enthusiastic as a describing word.
items.cn: 到 18 世纪，词尾 -ic 构成形容词 enthusiastic。

items.en: Enthusiastic now describes visible eagerness in any field.
items.cn: 现代英语中，enthusiastic 描述任何领域中看得见的热情。

note.en: Enthusiastic is the -ic adjective of enthusiasm, and it sits near its family and near words for eager and keen.
note.cn: enthusiastic 是 enthusiasm 的 -ic 形容词，与自身词族以及表示渴望和热切的词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who is very interested
wanting to do something very much

normalIntro.en: Enthusiastic is enthusiasm turned into an adjective with -ic.
normalIntro.cn: enthusiastic 是 enthusiasm 加 -ic 变成的形容词。

normal.en: Drop -ism and add -ic: the noun becomes the describing word.
normal.cn: 去掉 -ism 加上 -ic，名词就变成形容词。

normal.en: Enthusiastic about is the most common pattern.
normal.cn: enthusiastic about 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: An enthusiastic response is louder than a polite one.
normal.cn: enthusiastic response 比礼貌性的回应更热烈。

normal.en: The adverb enthusiastically adds -ally to the adjective.
normal.cn: 副词 enthusiastically 在形容词后加 -ally。

normal.en: Compare keen: keen is quieter and more common in British English.
normal.cn: 对比 keen：keen 更含蓄，在英式英语中更常见。

abstract.en: Picture hands raised before the question is finished.
abstract.cn: 想象问题还没问完，手已经举起来。

abstract.en: Imagine a door thrown open for a guest.
abstract.cn: 想象门被猛地拉开迎接客人。

abstract.en: Think of a face lit by a screen at midnight.
abstract.cn: 想象午夜时分被屏幕照亮的一张脸。

examples.en: The children were enthusiastic about the trip.
examples.cn: 孩子们对这次旅行充满热情。

examples.en: She gave an enthusiastic welcome to the guests.
examples.cn: 她热情地欢迎客人。

examples.en: His enthusiastic support helped the plan succeed.
examples.cn: 他的热情支持帮助计划取得成功。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「enthusiasm + tic」——热情像小动作一样藏不住，一阵一阵往外冒；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 theos（神）→ entheos（心中有神的）→ enthousiasmos（受神启的激情）→ 拉丁语 enthusiasmus → 英语 enthusiasm ＋ -ic → enthusiastic。

sensesIntro.en: The adjective describes the outer signs of the inner fire: bright interest, readiness to act, and warm approval.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个形容词描述内心之火的外在迹象：明亮的兴趣、随时行动的意愿，以及热烈的赞同。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit face leaning forward, eager to speak or act.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张发亮的脸向前倾，急着说话或行动。

branches.en: Visible interest is the basic adjective sense.
branches.cn: 看得见的兴趣，是形容词的基本义项。

branches.en: Readiness to act turns interest into participation.
branches.cn: 随时行动的意愿把兴趣变成参与。

branches.en: Warm approval directs the same energy at a plan.
branches.cn: 热烈赞同把同样的能量指向一项计划。

branches.en: An interested person usually wants to join in.
branches.cn: 有兴趣的人通常想参与。

branches.en: Eager helpers often give loud support.
branches.cn: 热心的帮手常常给出响亮的支持。

intro.en: Enthusiastic is enthusiasm reshaped with the adjective ending -ic.
intro.cn: enthusiastic 是 enthusiasm 加上形容词词尾 -ic 构成的。

latinIntro.en: Greek theos, god, lies behind the whole family, and the -ic ending is English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 theos（神）是整个词族的根源，-ic 词尾则来自英语。

items.exampleCN: en- 出现在 entheos 开头。

items.example: Theos is the heart of the family.
items.exampleCN: theos 是这个词族的核心。

items.example: Entheos supplies the image of inner fire.
items.exampleCN: entheos 提供内心之火的画面。

items.example: Enthousiasmos is the Greek noun source.
items.exampleCN: enthousiasmos 是希腊语名词来源。

items.example: Enthusiastic describes a person or response.

definition_en: in a way that shows strong excitement and interest
core_image: 挥着手、提高声音，把一件事说得像节日一样
scene: 孩子们一边鼓掌一边热情地喊出队名。The children clapped and shouted the team name enthusiastically.
sceneCN: 这里 enthusiastically 是「热情地」（第 1 个义项：以充满热情的方式）；句意：孩子们一边鼓掌，一边热情地喊出队名。

senses.title: With strong excitement
senses.definition: in a way that shows great excitement and interest
senses.definitionCN: 以表现出强烈兴奋与兴趣的方式
senses.example: She talked enthusiastically about her new job.
senses.exampleCN: 她热情地谈起自己的新工作。
senses.why: The adverb describes how an action is done, adding the heat of enthusiasm to the verb.
senses.whyCN: 副词描述动作如何进行，把 enthusiasm 的热度加到动词上。

senses.title: With eager approval
senses.definition: in a way that shows strong and warm support
senses.definitionCN: 以表现出强烈而热烈支持的方式
senses.example: The committee enthusiastically approved the new design.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会热烈地通过了新设计。
senses.why: Approval performed with excitement becomes enthusiastic approval.
senses.whyCN: 带着兴奋去赞同，就成为「热烈赞同」。

senses.title: With energetic effort
senses.definition: with a lot of energy and willingness to work
senses.definitionCN: 带着充沛精力与工作意愿
senses.example: He worked enthusiastically on the garden all summer.
senses.exampleCN: 他整个夏天都干劲十足地打理花园。
senses.why: The same inner fire can power steady work, not only speech.
senses.whyCN: 同样的内心之火也能驱动持续的工作，而不只是说话。

intro.en: Enthusiastically is enthusiastic plus -ally, the adverb ending used after adjectives in -ic.
intro.cn: enthusiastically 是 enthusiastic 加 -ally，这是 -ic 结尾形容词常用的副词词尾。

items.en: Theos means god, and entheos means inspired.
items.cn: theos 意为神，entheos 意为受神启的。

items.en: Enthousiasmos means divine possession.
items.cn: enthousiasmos 意为神灵附体。

items.en: Enthusiasmus carries the noun into Latin.
items.cn: enthusiasmus 把这个名词带入拉丁语。

items.en: Enthusiasm and enthusiastic settle into English usage.
items.cn: enthusiasm 与 enthusiastic 进入英语用法。

items.en: The adverb enthusiastically appears with the -ally ending.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，带 -ally 词尾的副词 enthusiastically 出现。

items.en: The adverb describes speech, support, and effort alike.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个副词既可描述言语，也可描述支持与努力。

note.en: Enthusiastically is the adverb of enthusiastic, and it sits near eagerly and warmly.
note.cn: enthusiastically 是 enthusiastic 的副词，与 eagerly 和 warmly 相邻。

entries.definition: a person who is very interested
in a way that shows strong desire
in a friendly and enthusiastic way

normalIntro.en: Enthusiastically is enthusiastic plus -ally, the standard adverb ending after -ic.
normalIntro.cn: enthusiastically 是 enthusiastic 加 -ally，这是 -ic 结尾形容词后的标准副词词尾。

normal.en: Adjectives ending in -ic usually take -ally, not just -ly.
normal.cn: -ic 结尾的形容词通常加 -ally，而不是只加 -ly。

normal.en: The adverb answers the question how: how did they respond? Enthusiastically.
normal.cn: 这个副词回答「怎样」：他们怎样回应？热情地。

normal.en: Speak enthusiastically is a common collocation.
normal.cn: speak enthusiastically 是常见搭配。

normal.en: The word often appears at the end of a sentence.
normal.cn: 这个词常出现在句末。

normal.en: Compare eagerly: eagerly stresses wanting, while enthusiastically stresses feeling.
normal.cn: 对比 eagerly：eagerly 强调「想要」，enthusiastically 强调「情感」。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd on its feet before the song ends.
abstract.cn: 想象歌还没唱完，观众已经全体起立。

abstract.en: Imagine a handshake that pulls the other person forward.
abstract.cn: 想象一次把对方拉近的握手。

abstract.en: Think of a voice rising at the end of a sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象句尾时声音扬起来。

examples.en: She talked enthusiastically about her new job.
examples.cn: 她热情地谈起自己的新工作。

examples.en: The committee enthusiastically approved the new design.
examples.cn: 委员会热烈地通过了新设计。

examples.en: He worked enthusiastically on the garden all summer.
examples.cn: 他整个夏天都干劲十足地打理花园。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「enthusiastic + ally」——热情像盟友一样跟着每个动作，就是热情地；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 theos（神）→ entheos（心中有神的）→ enthousiasmos（受神启的激情）→ enthusiasm → enthusiastic ＋ -ally → enthusiastically。

sensesIntro.en: The adverb carries the fire of enthusiasm into verbs, describing excited speech, warm approval, and energetic effort.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个副词把 enthusiasm 的火带进动词，描述兴奋的言语、热烈的赞同与充沛的努力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gesture and a raised voice carrying feeling into action.
core.cn: 核心意象：手势与提高的声音把感情带进动作。

branches.en: Excited speech is the most common use of the adverb.
branches.cn: 兴奋的言语，是这个副词最常见的用法。

branches.en: Warm approval makes agreement sound louder.
branches.cn: 热烈赞同让同意听起来更响亮。

branches.en: Energetic effort turns feeling into sustained work.
branches.cn: 充沛的努力把感情变成持续的工作。

branches.en: Speech and approval often share the same rising tone.
branches.cn: 言语与赞同常共享同一种上扬的语调。

branches.en: Approval can set a whole team to work with energy.
branches.cn: 赞同能让整个团队干劲十足地开工。

intro.en: Enthusiastically is the adverb of enthusiastic, built with the ending -ally.
intro.cn: enthusiastically 是 enthusiastic 的副词，由词尾 -ally 构成。

latinIntro.en: The chain runs from Greek theos, god, through enthusiasm, to the English adjective and its adverb.
latinIntro.cn: 这条链从希腊语 theos（神）经 enthusiasm，延伸到英语形容词及其副词。

items.example: Theos is the root of the family.
items.exampleCN: theos 是这个词族的根源。

items.example: Entheos gives the inner fire image.
items.exampleCN: entheos 提供内心之火的意象。

definition_zh: 全部的；整个的；完整无缺的
definition_en: whole, with no part missing or left out
core_image: 一块布从一头铺到另一头，没有一处缺口
scene: 大雪下了整整一夜，第二天整个村子都白了。Snow fell all night, and the entire village was white by morning.
sceneCN: 这里 entire 是「整个的」（第 1 个义项：完整无缺的全部）；句意：雪下了一整夜，到早晨整个村子都白了。

pos.zh: 全部的；整个的；完整无缺的

senses.title: Whole, with nothing left out
senses.definition: including every part of something, with nothing missing
senses.definitionCN: 包含某物的每一部分，没有遗漏
senses.example: The entire class passed the test.
senses.exampleCN: 全班都通过了考试。
senses.why: The Latin root means untouched and whole, so the adjective names a thing with no part removed.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「未被触碰、完整」，所以这个形容词指没有去掉任何部分的事物。

senses.title: Complete and unbroken
senses.definition: still in one piece, not damaged or divided
senses.definitionCN: 仍为一体，没有损坏或分裂
senses.example: The ancient wall is still entire after two thousand years.
senses.exampleCN: 两千年后，这堵古墙依然完整。
senses.why: The original sense of untouched survives in the idea of something whole and undamaged.
senses.whyCN: 「未被触碰」的原义，保留在「完整无损」这一含义中。

senses.title: Complete in degree
senses.definition: complete or total in an abstract sense, such as trust or agreement
senses.definitionCN: 在抽象意义上完全、彻底，如信任或一致
senses.example: He had the entire confidence of the board.
senses.exampleCN: 他拥有董事会的完全信任。
senses.why: Whole applied to abstract things means complete and unreserved.
senses.whyCN: 「整体」用于抽象事物，就表示完全、毫无保留。

intro.en: Entire comes from Latin integer, whole and untouched, from in-, not, and tangere, to touch, through Old French entier.
intro.cn: entire 来自拉丁语 integer（完整、未被触碰），由 in-（不）与 tangere（触碰）构成，经古法语 entier 进入英语。

items.en: Tangere means to touch or handle.
items.cn: tangere 意为触碰或接触。

items.en: In- here means not.
items.cn: 这里的 in- 表示「不」。

items.en: Integer means whole and untouched.
items.cn: integer 意为完整的、未被触碰的。

items.en: Entier keeps the sense of whole and complete.
items.cn: entier 保留「完整、完全」的意思。

items.en: Middle English entire describes something whole and sound.
items.cn: 中古英语 entire 描述完整而完好之物。

items.en: Modern English uses entire mainly for the whole of something.
items.cn: 现代英语中，entire 主要用于表示某事物的全部。

note.en: Entire is a wholeness word, and it sits near its family and near words for whole and complete.
note.cn: entire 是一个「完整」词，与自身词族以及表示全部和完整的词相邻。

entries.definition: to combine parts into a whole

normalIntro.en: Entire comes from Latin integer, untouched or whole, so the word pictures something with no part removed.
normalIntro.cn: entire 来自拉丁语 integer（未被触碰、完整），所以这个词描绘没有去掉任何部分的事物。

normal.en: Integer means whole, and it also gives us the mathematical integer.
normal.cn: integer 意为完整，也给我们数学中的「整数」。

normal.en: The entire day means all of it, with nothing left out.
normal.cn: the entire day 指一整天，没有遗漏。

normal.en: The adverb entirely means completely.
normal.cn: 副词 entirely 表示完全地。

normal.en: The noun entirety appears in the phrase in its entirety.
normal.cn: 名词 entirety 出现在短语 in its entirety 中。

normal.en: Compare whole: whole is plainer, while entire is slightly more formal.
normal.cn: 对比 whole：whole 更朴素，entire 稍正式。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet of paper with no corner torn away.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸没有任何一角被撕掉。

abstract.en: Imagine a circle closed without the smallest gap.
abstract.cn: 想象一个圆闭合得没有一丝缺口。

abstract.en: Think of a house lit from every window at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一座房子的每扇窗同时亮起。

examples.en: The entire class passed the test.
examples.cn: 全班都通过了考试。

examples.en: She read the entire report in one sitting.
examples.cn: 她一口气读完了整份报告。

examples.en: The entire village came to the wedding.
examples.cn: 全村人都来参加婚礼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「in + tire」——一条轮胎也没有漏掉，就是完整无缺的全部；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）＋ tangere（触碰）→ integer（完整无缺的）→ 古法语 entier → 中古英语 entire，核心义「未被触碰、完整」。

sensesIntro.en: The word keeps the old sense of untouched wholeness, then extends it to physical completeness and finally to complete trust or agreement.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词保留「未被触碰的完整」这一古老含义，再扩展到物理上的完好，最后用于完全的信任或一致。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole sheet spread out with no corner missing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一整块布铺开，没有缺角。

branches.en: Including every part is the dominant modern sense.
branches.cn: 包含每一部分，是现代主要义项。

branches.en: Physical soundness keeps the original untouched idea.
branches.cn: 物理上的完好保留原初「未被触碰」的意思。

branches.en: Complete trust applies wholeness to abstract things.
branches.cn: 完全的信任把「整体」用于抽象事物。

branches.en: Something whole in quantity is often also whole in condition.
branches.cn: 数量上完整的东西，状况上往往也完好。

branches.en: The whole of a thing can be given completely or trusted fully.
branches.cn: 事物的整体可以被完整给出，也可以被完全信任。

intro.en: Entire is a Latin adjective reshaped by French, and its English family grows with -ly, -ty, and -ness.
intro.cn: entire 是经法语改造的拉丁形容词，英语词族由 -ly、-ty 与 -ness 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin integer means whole or untouched, from in-, not, and tangere, to touch.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 integer 意为完整或未被触碰，由 in-（不）与 tangere（触碰）构成。

items.exampleCN: in- 在 integer 中否定 tangere。

items.example: Tangere supplies the idea of touch.
Integer is the direct Latin source.
items.exampleCN: integer 是直接的拉丁语来源。

items.example: Entier carries the word into French.
items.exampleCN: entier 把这个词带入法语。
entirely 表示在每一部分上。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的词尾
表示状态或性质的词尾

items.example: Entireness is a rare synonym of entirety.
items.exampleCN: entireness 是 entirety 的罕见同义词。
